notes.title: Hot Spring Hero release！
notes.notes:
An RPG where you can spend a slow life with a cute and cute heroine in a hot spring area!
[Onsen Hero] is now on sale!
We are also holding a launch sale, so let's take this opportunity to have a slow life!
